games.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
games.display_name: 鬼武者 Way of the Sword
games.name_zh_tw: 鬼武者 Way of the Sword
games.name_zh_cn: 鬼武者 Way of the Sword
games.name_zh_tw_traditional: 鬼武者 Way of the Sword
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 鬼武者 Way of the Sword
games.short_description: 本作是以血洗血的至高無上劍鬥動作遊戲。在幻化成了不可思議的樣貌的「京都」， 一名手臂戴著「鬼之籠手」的武士奔馳各地，斬殺猖獗的幻魔。武士在壯烈的劍鬥中以血沐身，尋求戰鬥的意義。自身所踏上的道路，終究會通往何處？
games.short_description_en: An Oni Gauntlet-wielding samurai makes a stand in Kyoto against the encroaching Genma menace. Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

games.name: NBA 2K27
games.short_description: 《NBA 2K27》拼勁不減，征途永無止境。在MyCAREER、MyTEAM和MyNBA時時刻刻追求卓越，讓籃球夢化為現實。
games.short_description_en: The hustle doesn’t stop and the run never ends in NBA 2K27. Chase greatness around the clock in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, and MyNBA, and make your hoop dreams a reality.

games.name: Alchemy Factory
games.short_description: 從一間小小店鋪開始，邀請好友合作，靈活運用輸送帶、輸送管與魔法裝置打造自動化產線，將藥劑、珠寶與聖物送上貨架，完成委託、累積財富，打造專屬於你的中世紀煉金工廠，成為富甲一方的煉金大亨！《煉金工廠》1.0 正式版現已推出，快來體驗貨車系統與全面升級的店鋪經營玩法吧！
games.short_description_en: Start small, team up with friends, and automate production with conveyor belts, pipes, and magical devices. Stock your shop with potions, jewelry, and relics, complete commissions, and build an alchemy empire! Alchemy Factory 1.0 is out now with the Wagon Logistics System and revamped shopkeeping.

games.name: Orc Incremental
games.short_description: 從一名獸人出發，建立一支勢不可擋的黑暗軍團，征服世界。在這款放置自動戰鬥遊戲中，完善你的陣型，召喚強大的野獸，解鎖強力升級，每次重生後愈發強大。
games.short_description_en: Start with a single orc and build an unstoppable dark army to conquer the realms in this incremental auto battler. Perfect your formation, summon mighty beasts, unlock powerful upgrades, and grow stronger with each rebirth.

games.name: Valheim
games.short_description: 一款支援 1 至 10 人合作探索的生存遊戲。踏入受維京文化啟發、隨機生成的死後世界，戰鬥、建造、征服，創造你的傳奇，贏得奧丁的青睞！
games.short_description_en: A collaborative exploration and survival game for 1-10 players, set in a procedurally generated afterlife inspired by Viking culture. Battle, build, and conquer your way to a saga worthy of Odin’s patronage!

games.name: Halloween: The Game
games.short_description: 1978 年的萬聖夜，沒有人能逃離麥克·邁爾斯。化身惡靈傳說「Boogeyman」，或挺身對抗邪惡化身，一切盡在《Halloween》。
games.short_description_en: On Halloween night, 1978, no one is safe from Michael Myers. Become the Boogeyman or fight back against the face of evil itself in Halloween.

games.name: WARDOGS
games.short_description: 《WARDOGS》是一款戰術型全面戰爭 FPS 遊戲，共一百名玩家分成三支隊伍，爭奪控制區域。背景設定於東歐荒廢的工業山區，在可破壞的戰場上作戰並賺取金錢，因為現金為王。
games.short_description_en: WARDOGS is a TACTICAL ALL OUT WARFARE FPS where one hundred players split across three teams fight over the control zone. Set in the derelict industrial mountains of Eastern Europe on a destructible battlefield where teamwork pays and cash is king.

games.name: Welcome to Elderfield
games.short_description: 精美手繪藝術風格，搭配暗黑風格Lofi音樂，溫馨又恐怖的古原鎮等你來探索！在這款角色扮演遊戲中種田畜牧，與小鎮居民成為朋友或伴侶，調查各類秘詭，裝飾自己的小窩，與恐怖的生物激戰，釣魚烹飪，尋找古神，每晚睡下都有可能再也無法醒來……古原鎮的生活精彩紛呈，你絕不會感到無聊！
games.short_description_en: Welcome to Elderfield, a cozy horror RPG with hand-drawn art and dark lofi music. Manage your farm, befriend or romance the locals, investigate mysteries, decorate your home, fight terrifying creatures, fish, cook, seek the Old Gods, die in your sleep, and more... There's lots to do in Elderfield!

games.name: Dumb Ways to Build
games.short_description: 《Dumb Ways to Build》是一款混亂、大玩物理效果的合作建造遊戲。快和朋友組隊集結你的工班，一起接下危險的建築工程。裝備很齊全，腦袋卻空空，大家一起齊心協力蓋出前進的道路，不然就等著出包送命！
games.short_description_en: Dumb Ways to Build is a chaotic, physics-based co-op game. Team up with friends to assemble your crew and take-on dangerous construction jobs. With all the gear and no idea, work together to build your path forward, or die trying!

games.name: Rehaunted
games.short_description: 進入一棟每條線索都透著詭異的房子。調查一處殘忍的犯罪現場，揭開隱藏的證據，並使用你的偵探工具，拼湊出埋藏在寂靜之下的駭人真相。
games.short_description_en: Enter a house where every clue feels wrong. Investigate a brutal crime scene, uncover hidden evidence, and use your detective tools to piece together a disturbing truth buried beneath the silence.

games.name: Aniimo
games.short_description: 《伊莫》是一款全新型態的多人連線大世界捉寵RPG。你將踏上遼闊的艾德爾大陸，與各種不可思議的神奇生物「伊莫」奇妙邂逅。透過獨特的連結系統，你將能和牠們合體、繼承強大能力，以全新的視角探索世界。此外，還能前往充滿科技感的浮空都市，與來自各地的冒險家交流、競技，譜寫你的旅程日記。快帶著夥伴伊莫，展開一場超越想像的奇幻冒險吧！
games.short_description_en: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

games.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
games.short_description: 開設您自己的卡牌商店。擺放最新的補充包，也可以拆開收集卡牌。自行定價、僱用員工、舉辦活動，並拓展您的卡牌商店。
games.short_description_en: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

games.name: Active Matter
games.short_description: 在這款背景設在破碎多重宇宙中的全新逼真軍事射擊遊戲中，加入危險的戰利品搜刮行動或大型玩家對戰。在量子不穩定區中爭奪活性物質控制權，收集這種能夠扭曲時間和空間的物質。
games.short_description_en: Join dangerous raids for loot or intense PvP/PvE battles in this new realistic military shooter set in a fractured multiverse. Fight in quantum-unstable zones for control of active matter - the substance that bends time and space.

games.name: Batomon Showdown
games.short_description: 在這款寵物收集的自走棋遊戲中，收集各種鬥靈，組建鬥靈夢之隊，進化獨具特色的鬥靈，探索致命的技能協同，打造最強隊伍，在快節奏的爽快對戰中擊敗其他玩家，成為最強訓靈師！
games.short_description_en: Creature-collecting pvp async auto battler where you choose your trainer, select your Batomon and assemble the ultimate team to take down other players! Play at your own pace while you discover new deadly team combos and synergies! Break the game by training your Batomon to overpowered levels.

games.name: DEATH PENALTY
games.short_description: YOU ARE SENTENCED TO DEATH... Slither your way through an impenetrable fortress crawling with devils faster, stronger, and more cunning than any human. By sheer luck you've slipped through the cracks, but discovery means certain death. How long are you going to delay the inevitable?
games.short_description_en: YOU ARE SENTENCED TO DEATH... Slither your way through an impenetrable fortress crawling with devils faster, stronger, and more cunning than any human. By sheer luck you've slipped through the cracks, but discovery means certain death. How long are you going to delay the inevitable?

games.name: OpenFront
games.short_description: OpenFront 是一個緊張刺激的 PvP 大逃殺遊戲，數百個玩家將在廣闊的地圖上衝突、締結盟約、積累財富、並發動核武攻擊統治世界。
games.short_description_en: A massively multiplayer real-time strategy game pitting hundreds of players against one another. Over one million nuke each other every month.

games.name: Police Chief Simulator
games.short_description: Welcome to Winston Springs, Officer! The local police station is in urgent need of a Chief of Police, and you’ve been chosen for the job! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!
games.short_description_en: Welcome to Winston Springs, Officer! The local police station is in urgent need of a Chief of Police, and you’ve been chosen for the job! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

games.name: lily's world XD
games.short_description: 2004 年，有個普通的少女叫做莉莉，你偶然間發現了她的筆記型電腦。閱讀她的日記，查看她和朋友的聊天紀錄，及時拼湊出真相。不過小心了，還有其他人也連上了她的電腦……本作是打破第四面牆的心理恐怖遊戲。
games.short_description_en: Lily was an ordinary teenager in 2004, and you just found her laptop. Read her diary, message her friends, and piece together what happened to her before it’s too late. But you're not the only one with access to her computer… A fourth wall-breaking psychological horror experience featuring LilyPichu

games.name: The Plant Shop
games.short_description: 這是一款溫馨的恐怖遊戲，你需要經營一家小型植物店，為深夜顧客製作植物。擴充你的植物收藏，升級你的店鋪，發展你的生意。
games.short_description_en: A cozy horror game where you craft plants for late-night customers while you manage a small plant shop. Expand your plant collection, upgrade your shop & grow your business.

games.name: Dawson Oaks Trailer Park
games.short_description: A proximity voice chat social deduction game where criminals must commit secret crimes while a Supervisor hunts them, and a hidden Snitch betrays them from within.
games.short_description_en: A proximity voice chat social deduction game where criminals must commit secret crimes while a Supervisor hunts them, and a hidden Snitch betrays them from within.

games.name: Poopy's Playland
games.short_description: 扮演一位悲痛的母親，她的孩子一年前在遊樂園中失蹤。使用手電筒在黑暗中前進，解決可重複遊玩的謎題，並躲避不穩定的殺手機器人吉祥物！調查謎團，找出真相……
games.short_description_en: Play as a grieving mother whose child went missing in a playland one year ago. Use your trusty flashlight to navigate through the dark, solve replayable puzzles to progress forward, and hide from the unstable killer mascots! Investigate the mysteries and find out the truth...

games.name: DISCIPLINE SIMULATOR
games.short_description: 🔥 最多支援 8 人的硬派紀律模擬器！💪 全速鍛鍊力量，贏得勝利！上傳你的目標照片、使用各式小道具，在瘋狂的大規模混戰中痛擊對手。揮灑汗水、稱霸全場，成為至高無上的紀律之神！😈
games.short_description_en: 🔥 UP TO 8-PLAYER HARDCORE DISCIPLINE SIMULATOR!!! 💪 Build power at max speed and WIN! Upload your target pics, use gadgets, and wreck faces in insane massive brawls! Dominate, sweat, and become the ABSOLUTE GOD OF DISCIPLINE!!! 😈

games.name: Night Record: Thin Walls
games.short_description: 歡迎來到這棟樓。你的丈夫走了，如今他的鑰匙歸你了。樓梯要掃，鍋爐要添煤，鄰居們在等著。進來吧，關上門，仔細聽。這裡很安靜。安靜得不對勁。
games.short_description_en: Welcome to the building. Your husband is gone, and his keys are yours now. The stairs need sweeping, the boiler needs feeding, the neighbors are waiting. Come in, close the door, and listen. It's quiet here. Quiet in all the wrong ways.

games.name: Dressmaker
games.short_description: 當個裁縫師吧!在這款溫馨的裁縫工藝遊戲中，選擇布料、裁剪紙型，將它們縫製成各類服裝，來取悅（或搞砸！）挑剔的鄉民們。這款遊戲的靈感來自真實的服裝製作過程。
games.short_description_en: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.

games.name: Happy Wheels
games.short_description: 挑選一位準備不足的參賽者，無視可能造成的嚴重後果，拚命追求那短暫的勝利。
games.short_description_en: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.

games.name: Normal Golf Game
games.short_description: A very normal golf simulator. Hit anything. Shoot from anywhere. But remember: you’re not leaving until Luke Muscat himself (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride) is satisfied.
games.short_description_en: A very normal golf simulator. Hit anything. Shoot from anywhere. But remember: you’re not leaving until Luke Muscat himself (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride) is satisfied.

games.name: Rivage
games.short_description: 《Rivage》是一款沉浸式科幻解謎冒險遊戲，故事發生在困於星際異象的A.R.E.S.太空站。你將以Miranda的身分醒來，在太空站內探索、破解精巧謎題，努力揭開失蹤船員的真相。
games.short_description_en: Rivage is a first person escape room-style puzzle game. Trapped in a cosmic anomaly aboard the A.R.E.S. space station, wake up as Miranda, a brilliant scientist and solve intricate puzzles to unravel the fate of your missing crew.

games.name: Delverium
games.short_description: 在這款最多支持8人聯機的沙盒生存冒險遊戲中，你將與同伴共同探索未知世界。製作物品、搭建居所、深入險地，揭開侵襲而來的“故障”之謎，還這片土地一個安寧。
games.short_description_en: Explore, Build, Farm, Craft and Fight in this survival sandbox adventure for 1-8 players. Delve deep to uncover the secret of the invading 'Faults' and restore stability to the land.

games.name: Ved: Recure
games.short_description: 《Ved:療癒所》是一款快節奏的動作roguelite遊戲。你將扮演一名逐漸失去遊戲熱情的成年人，被困在自己購買的第1000款買了不玩的遊戲裡，和多位不同能力、不同性格的可操作角色，運用完全自訂搭配的Buff鏈，面對強力的敵人，格擋！閃避！用自己的操作和BD通關這第1000款遊戲，回到現實世界。
games.short_description_en: "Ved: Recure" is a fast-paced action roguelite where you find yourself trapped inside the 1000th game you bought but never played. You’ll wield fully customizable buff chains to face off against formidable foes and strategic builds to conquer this 1000th game and make your way back to reality.

games.name: Airport Control 27
games.short_description: 機場管制 Airport Control 是新一代 3D 空中交通管制模擬遊戲。你將在世界各地的機場中擔任不同席位的 ATC，引導航班滑行，調配跑道起降，無論白天黑夜，無論大風雨雪，在安全的前提下，確保航班按時進出港。請牢記：在崗一分鐘，安全60秒！
games.short_description_en: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.

games.name: Well Dweller
games.short_description: 《黯井微光》是一款暗黑童話風格的類銀河城遊戲，講述了棲身於破敗王國中的一群迷人角色的故事。玩家將扮演一隻手持火柴棒的小鳥——微光，踏上焚滅邪惡女王、拯救家族的旅程。
games.short_description_en: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

games.name: POOL LOOP
games.short_description: 你受困於一座無止盡循環的室內游泳池。 仔細檢查游泳池，找出異常。 如果覺得哪裡不對，就按下紅色按鈕；如果一切正常，就按下綠色按鈕。 判斷錯誤，循環就會繼續。
games.short_description_en: You are trapped in an endlessly looping indoor swimming pool. Inspect the pool carefully and look for anomalies. If anything feels wrong, press the RED button. If everything seems normal, press the GREEN button. Make the wrong call, and the loop continues.

games.name: Graveyard Keeper 2
games.short_description: 史上最不靠譜的中世紀墓園模擬器殺回來了！重建城鎮、打理墓園、實現生產自動化，率領你的亡靈大軍奔赴戰場，把殭屍生意做大做強！《守墓人2》來更大的經營版圖，更完整的自動化系統，作為一部極其荒誕離奇的續作，喪心病狂程度史無前例！
games.short_description_en: The most inaccurate medieval cemetery sim is back! Restore The Town, manage the graveyard, automate production, lead your undead army into battle and turn the zombie problem into a thriving business! Graveyard Keeper 2 is the grotesque sequel that's deeper than six feet, and more unhinged than ever!

games.name: SILENT HILL: Townfall
games.short_description: 賽門·奧戴爾為了「撥亂反正」而重返島嶼小鎮，卻深陷駭人的環境，只能謹慎躲避，面對火爆衝突，還要解開艱難的謎題，才能使聖愛蜜莉亞的真相逐步浮出水面。
games.short_description_en: Returning to an island town to ‘put things right’, Simon Ordell descends into a world of tense evasion, explosive confrontations, and mind-bending puzzles that slowly surface the truth of St. Amelia.

games.name: Nocturne
games.short_description: 死後世界已經數位化。在這款融合多種風格、採用獨特節奏戰鬥的角色扮演遊戲中，探索永生背後必須付出的代價。
games.short_description_en: The afterlife is now digital. Discover that eternal life comes with sacrifice in a genre-defying RPG with unique rhythm combat.

games.name: Echoes in Darkness
games.short_description: 《Echoes in Darkness》是一款第一人稱心理恐怖體驗
games.short_description_en: Echoes in Darkness is a first-person psychological horror experience.

games.name: CONTROL Resonant
games.short_description: 在這款驚險刺激的動作冒險角色扮演遊戲中，探索距超自然毀滅只剩一步之遙的扭曲曼哈頓。發揮迪倫法登的超凡能力，對抗扭曲現實的宇宙威脅，為他自身的人性和我們的存亡奮戰。
games.short_description_en: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and our survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

games.name: The Magus Circle
games.short_description: 魔法即藝術。The Magus Circle 是一款通過親手繪製符文來施放魔法的類《吸血鬼倖存者》Roguelite 遊戲！邂逅其他法師，解鎖他們的能力。揭開隱藏在魔法陣中的秘密。繪製符文，守護魔法陣，拯救宇宙。
games.short_description_en: Magic is Art. The Magus Circle is a vampire-survivors, rogue-lite game where you draw to cast spells! Meet other mages and unlock their abilities. Discover the secrets hidden inside the Circle. Draw the sigil, protect the circle, save the cosmos.

games.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
games.short_description: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis 是一款奇幻塔防策略遊戲，帶你回到王國的早期時代，並加入大膽全新的玩法變化。建造防禦塔、指揮英雄，在 Vez'nan 的腐化撕裂整個王國之前，阻止他的陰謀！
games.short_description_en: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis is a fantasy tower defense strategy game that takes you back in time to the early days of the Kingdom with bold new twists. Build towers, command heroes, and stop Vez’nan’s corruption before it tears the kingdom apart!

games.name: Slow Roads
games.short_description: 在綿延不盡的風景中一路開下去，放空片刻。生成一個獨特的世界，按心情設定場景，只管向前……
games.short_description_en: Zone out on an endless drive through infinite scenic landscapes. Generate a unique world, set the scene to suit your mood, and just drive...

games.name: SiN Reloaded
games.short_description: 《SiN: Reloaded》是對1998年同名射擊遊戲的全面重製之作。這款劇情驅動的第一人稱射擊遊戲堪稱一枚未經雕琢的璞玉，不僅擁有令人難忘的角色、可怕的敵人，而且還有能將Quake II Engine發揮到極致的毀滅性軍火庫。如今，《SiN: Reloaded》將帶著精美的重製畫面和全面升級的控制體系強勢迴歸。
games.short_description_en: SiN: Reloaded is a completely remastered experience of the 1998 shooter. This diamond-in-the-rough, story-driven FPS features memorable characters, horrific enemies, and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits. Now with remastered graphics and overhauled control schemes.

games.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27
games.short_description: 歡迎來到《EA SPORTS FC™ 27》的全世界的遊戲。 走進 The Grounds，體驗一個讓街頭與球場結合的足球遊樂場，並在每個模式中感受更強大的操控，因為社群驅動的創新帶來更貼近真實足球的遊戲玩法。
games.short_description_en: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.

games.name: Wild West Pioneers
games.short_description: 《西部拓荒紀》是一款城市建造冒險遊戲，你將帶領一群拓荒者深入尚未開墾的西部邊疆。建設並管理不斷發展的聚落，建立完整的生產鏈，探索廣袤世界，並親歷一段關於淘金夢想、危險遭遇與尋找家人的西部故事。
games.short_description_en: Wild West Pioneers is a city-builder adventure about leading settlers into the untamed frontier. Build and manage growing settlements, establish production chains, and explore the world. Follow a story of gold rush dreams, dangerous encounters, and the search for your family.

games.name: Dragon Shelter
games.short_description: 在這款溫馨的奇幻生活模擬遊戲中，你將與魔法小龍夥伴們一同重建一座遭人遺忘的農場。種植作物，烹飪療癒身心的美食，幫助愁雲慘淡的小鎮重新找回喜悅，同時重新建立人類與龍之間的羈絆。
games.short_description_en: Dragon Shelter is a farming sim set in a fantasy world. Become a hero who'll reignite the long-lost friendship between humans and dragons. Care for wondrous creatures, explore the magical world, and cook enchanted dishes together!

games.name: Woman Simulator
games.short_description: 這款遊戲讓你體會身為女性的感受：打掃、洗衣、做飯，沒有片刻安寧。完全沉浸於女性煩惱的世界。
games.short_description_en: Experience life as a woman - cleaning, cooking, laundry, and no time to rest. Full immersion into the world of everyday chaos!

games.name: Backrooms: Code Yellow
games.short_description: An online 1-6 player co-op game about investigating and collecting data in the infinitely massive Backrooms with your fellow employees. Explore. Do your job. Return alive.
games.short_description_en: An online 1-6 player co-op game about investigating and collecting data in the infinitely massive Backrooms with your fellow employees. Explore. Do your job. Return alive.

games.name: GHOSTED
games.short_description: 驚嚇活人，收集他們的恐懼，解鎖通往愈發離奇領域的大門。在這款支持 1-5 人合作的恐怖喜劇遊戲中，踏上重獲新生的旅程。
games.short_description_en: Haunt the living and collect their fear to unlock doors leading to increasingly bizarre realms on your journey toward resurrection in this 1-5 co-op horror comedy.

games.name: Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional
games.short_description: The family computer is infected again and it’s your job to fend off waves of viruses and adware foes with an arsenal of nostalgic Y2K-inspired weapons. Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional is a survivor-like auto-shooter filled with nods to the days when computers were actually fun.
games.short_description_en: The family computer is infected again and it’s your job to fend off waves of viruses and adware foes with an arsenal of nostalgic Y2K-inspired weapons. Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional is a survivor-like auto-shooter filled with nods to the days when computers were actually fun.

games.name: Nivalis Nights
games.short_description: 擴張你的商業版圖、經營餐廳與夜店、結交盟友或豎立宿敵、購買並裝潢專屬公寓、享受垂釣時光，甚至可能在這座從汪洋延伸至雲端的賽博龐克都市中，邂逅一段浪漫真愛。
games.short_description_en: Grow your business, manage restaurants and nightclubs, make friends and enemies, buy and decorate apartments, go fishing and maybe even find love in a cyberpunk city that stretches from the ocean to the clouds.

games.name: Transport Fever 3
games.short_description: 經典運輸模擬遊戲《運輸業大亨3》強勢回歸，帶來規模更大、更深入、更豐富的運輸體驗。運用百年來不斷發展的各式交通工具，打造改寫世界樣貌的陸、海、空交通路線，設計並建構你理想中的運輸網路。
games.short_description_en: Transport Fever 3, the ultimate transport tycoon returns, bigger, deeper, and more dynamic than ever. Build the routes that transform the world across land, sea, and sky using over a century of evolving transport options. Design and build your ideal transport network.

games.name: Minecraft Dungeons II
games.short_description: 一個降臨主世界的新的威脅...
games.short_description_en: A new threat descends upon the Overworld...

games.name: Way of the Hunter 2
games.short_description: 在遼闊的北美洲與非洲荒野中，體驗最先進、真實，且視覺震撼的狩獵冒險。一窺栩栩如生的動物行為、動態多變的生態系統，還有危險無比的野生動物，並在小屋中放滿各式各樣的戰利品
games.short_description_en: Experience the most advanced, realistic, and visually stunning hunting adventure across vast wilderness in North America and Africa. Encounter lifelike animal behavior, dynamic ecosystems, and dangerous wildlife while building a collection of trophies in your lodge.

games.name: Dicevaders
games.short_description: 在《骰之侵略者》這款與《星之侵略者》同宇宙設定的骰子肉鴿遊戲中，組建一支外星侵略者大軍去征服地球吧！
games.short_description_en: Dicevaders is a dice-based roguelike deckbuilder about leading the ultimate alien invasion. Set in the StarVaders universe, draft and manipulate the dice row, build an unstoppable army, and unleash adrenaline pumping combos through powerful synergies and strategic play.

games.name: Neighbors: Suburban Warfare
games.short_description: NEIGHBORS: Suburban Warfare 是一款輕鬆愉快的團隊 PvP 遊戲，主題是社區戰爭！ 設下陷阱和路障來防禦你的房子。 制定策略並收集附近資源來獲得超棒物品，打敗你的鄰居！
games.short_description_en: Neighbors: Suburban Warfare is a chaotic online multiplayer party brawler where suburban rivals go to war. Team up with friends in wild PvE and PvP matches, destroy rival houses with everyday items turned weapons, and defend your home using traps, gadgets, and crazy team combos.

games.name: Songs of Glimmerwick
games.short_description: 沉浸在一個音樂與林地奇幻交織的世界中，施展法術就像演奏歌曲般輕鬆自如。在這款劇情導向的女巫學院RPG遊戲中，你將上課學習、打理學校花園、與同學與鎮民建立友誼，並探索島上諸多奇聞異事與謎團。
games.short_description_en: Become immersed in a musical woodland fantasy world where casting a spell is as easy as playing a song. Attend classes, grow the university garden, make friends with classmates and townsfolk, and explore the island’s many oddities and mysteries in this story-driven witch academy RPG.

games.name: Needle In A Haystack
games.short_description: 與最多 5 位好友一起，在超過 1000 萬根乾草中找出藏起來的那根針。
games.short_description_en: Find a needle hidden in over 10 million pieces of hay with up to 5 other friends.

games.name: RetroSpace
games.short_description: 在這款舞曲龐克太空恐怖遊戲中，你可以走偷偷摸摸路線，也可以化身為異變的爽片英雄，在被黑洞吞噬的太空站上求生存。這趟燒腦航行有詭異生物、沉浸式體驗、時空跳躍，還有 70 年代八字鬍！
games.short_description_en: Immersive, disco-punk, space horror where you can be a sneaky chap or a mutant action hero as you try to survive on a space station swallowed by a black hole. A mind-bending ride with weird creatures, immersive features, time jumps, and '70s mustaches!

games.name: DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Complete Edition Remastered
games.display_name: 真・三國無雙２ with 猛將傳 Remastered
games.name_zh_tw: 真・三國無雙２ with 猛將傳 Remastered
games.name_zh_cn: 真・三国无双２ with 猛将传 Remastered
games.name_zh_tw_traditional: 真・三國無雙２ with 猛將傳 Remastered
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 真・三國無雙２ with 猛將傳 Remastered
games.short_description: 震撼重現，一騎當千的極致體驗。《真・三國無雙2》與《真・三國無雙２ 猛將傳》經典重現，傳奇再臨！更加爽快的動作體驗，挑戰一騎當千的極致境界！
games.short_description_en: A warrior worth a thousand reforged. A remake of DYNASTY WARRIORS 3 and DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends with modern graphics and even more thrilling action.

games.name: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE
games.display_name: 空戰奇兵8 希孚之翼 (ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE)
games.name_zh_tw: 空戰奇兵8 希孚之翼 (ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE)
games.name_zh_cn: 空战奇兵8 希孚之翼 (ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE)
games.name_zh_tw_traditional: 空戰奇兵8 希孚之翼 (ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE)
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 空戰奇兵8 希孚之翼 (ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE)
games.short_description: 享受在空中自由自在翱翔的爽快感，依據自身判斷將敵人接二連三擊墜破的快感，打破艱難局面化成為英雄成就感的戲劇性飛行射擊遊戲。最高峰的天空‧大自然‧都市畫面以及強大帶入感的劇場表現，讓玩家體驗真正的王牌駕駛員故事。
games.short_description_en: Soar through the skies and rise above every challenge to earn your place among the elite. Engage in intense aerial combat to dominate the battlefield with powerful weapons. Experience a breathtaking campaign filled with high-stakes missions, hard choices, and deep squad connections.

games.name: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™
games.short_description: 《星際大戰：銀河賽車手™》是一款以連場賽事為核心、刺激高風險的賽車體驗，故事發生在無法無天的邊境星域。隨著帝國覆滅、銀河系重建，銀河聯盟應運而生：這裡是一個地下、未經官方認可的賽車聯盟，各大犯罪集團在此資助混亂，鍛造新世代冠軍。
games.short_description_en: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ is a ​runs-based, ​high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.short_description: 體驗「事變日」——遊戲界最廣受好評的第三人稱射擊系列之一的殘酷起源故事。
games.short_description_en: Experience Emergence Day – the brutal origin story of one of gaming’s most acclaimed third-person shooter franchises.

games.name: Gridlords
games.short_description: 深入異步自動對戰策略PvP遊戲《城戰王者》，一探像素奇幻世界。建造你的終極城堡，指揮傳奇英雄智取勁敵，證明你才是雄圖大略的至尊王者。
games.short_description_en: Gridlords is a strategic async-PvP autobattler set in a fantasy pixel-art world. Build your ultimate castle, command legendary heroes, and outsmart rivals to prove your strategy reigns supreme.

games.name: Borrowed Sight
games.short_description: A mysterious epidemic violently killed millions in hours. Sealed inside a darkened van, your only connection to the silent, altered city is a damaged remote-controlled car. Navigate using coordinates, angles, and camera feeds to uncover the truth without drawing the attention of what remains.
games.short_description_en: A mysterious epidemic violently killed millions in hours. Sealed inside a darkened van, your only connection to the silent, altered city is a damaged remote-controlled car. Navigate using coordinates, angles, and camera feeds to uncover the truth without drawing the attention of what remains.

games.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
games.short_description: 以前所未有的方式體驗傳奇恐怖系列的全新篇章。克里夫巴克的《養鬼吃人：復甦》將第一人稱的動作恐怖生存遊戲帶往新的境界。
games.short_description_en: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.

games.name: Invokyr
games.short_description: 一款以詛咒桌遊為主題的多人合作生存恐怖遊戲。一盒塵封的棋盤，一棟鬧鬼的老宅。最多可與5位好友一起遊玩。擲出骰子，在召喚而出的恐怖中求生，擊敗遊戲主宰，贏回你的自由。
games.short_description_en: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play in a group of 6 players. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.

games.name: Forever Ago
games.short_description: 經歷了一場無情的命運打擊後，艾佛烈踏上了向北的旅程，在這場單人公路冒險中尋求救贖。
games.short_description_en: Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption in this single-player road trip adventure.

games.name: SPAM
games.short_description: SPAM is a free-to-play online turn-based combat game. Jump into dynamic battles where you’ll have to adapt to your opponents and try to impose your strategy. Earn new cards through your victories and create devastating combos!!
games.short_description_en: SPAM is a free-to-play online turn-based combat game. Jump into dynamic battles where you’ll have to adapt to your opponents and try to impose your strategy. Earn new cards through your victories and create devastating combos!!

games.name: Permafrost
games.short_description: 《Permafrost》是一款劇情導向生存沙盒遊戲，遊戲場景設定於冰封的末日後世界。探索廣闊且充滿故事的開放世界，單人或四人合作遊戲。在冰天雪地之中探索、拾荒、製作並建造避難所網路。
games.short_description_en: Permafrost is a story-driven survival sandbox set in a frozen, post-apocalyptic world. Discover a vast lore-rich open world, alone or in co-op with up to 4 players. Explore, scavenge, craft, and build a network of shelters to outlast the cold.

games.name: Silver Pines
games.short_description: 《銀松鎮》是類銀河戰士惡魔城生存恐怖遊戲，背景為一座美國小鎮。和恐怖生物戰鬥並解決謎題，在揭開謎團時謹慎管理稀有資源，可能就是得救的關鍵。
games.short_description_en: Silver Pines is a survival horror metroidvania set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: Order of the Sinking Star
games.short_description: 由《時空幻境》《見證者》的導演喬納森·布洛打造的敘事冒險遊戲，《沉星之序》將帶你踏入一個魔法與謎團交織的世界。破解超過1000個精心設計、相互關聯的謎題，邂逅獨特的可操控英雄，掌握不斷演變的玩法機制，最終揭開一場宏大的謎局。
games.short_description_en: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a massive puzzle adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.

games.name: Car Park Capital
games.short_description: 汽車行業需要你設計並建造平靜小鎮生活從未見過的頂級停車場。激發人們對汽車通勤的需求，把街區變成停車場！用宣傳攻勢說服人們為此掏錢，並與那些看穿你這門油水生意的人鬥到底。
games.short_description_en: The car industry needs you to design and build the greatest car parks that simple town life hasn't seen before. Introduce the need for car commuting and turn neighborhoods into car parks! Use propaganda to convince people to pay you for it. Fight people that see through your oily business.

games.name: Japanese Ramen Simulator
games.short_description: 《Japanese Ramen Simulator》是一款最多支援六人遊玩的拉麵店經營模擬遊戲。準備食材、煮麵、擺放配料，製作講究的一碗。開發原創菜色，自由設計廚房與用餐區。無論與朋友合作還是獨自經營，都朝理想中的人氣拉麵店邁進！
games.short_description_en: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a ramen shop management sim for up to six players. Prepare ingredients, cook noodles, and arrange toppings to craft the perfect bowl. Create original dishes, design your kitchen and dining area, and build your ramen restaurant with friends or on your own!

games.name: Hood Warfare 2
games.short_description: Rival gangs fight for control of Chicago. Pick a side, customize your weapons, and fight other players across a variety of action-packed game modes. Spin the block and take over the streets in this chaotic multiplayer FPS.
games.short_description_en: Rival gangs fight for control of Chicago. Pick a side, customize your weapons, and fight other players across a variety of action-packed game modes. Spin the block and take over the streets in this chaotic multiplayer FPS.

games.name: Truckful
games.short_description: 駕駛你的小貨車穿越看似平靜的鄉村山谷，為當地村民輸送重要貨物，並揭開小鎮的神秘面紗。請注意，古老的森林正在注視著你。
games.short_description_en: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: PAPERHEAD
games.short_description: 在可愛的紙板世界，發生了恐怖的差錯……使用魔法鉛筆、可靠的老散彈槍，還有各種其他武器，再加上你的萬能靴子的強大力量，探索黑暗的真相，還有搞清楚……為什麼紙板會流血？
games.short_description_en: In the cute cardboard world, something went horribly wrong... Use the magical pencil, a good old shotgun, and various other weapons as well as the strength of your mighty boots, to uncover the dark truth and find out WHY WOULD CARDBOARD... BLEED?

games.name: Battleplan
games.short_description: 《Battleplan》是一款歷史向二戰即時戰略遊戲，擁有無與倫比的真實感和模擬度。玩家可以在基於真實地理數據打造而成的龐大戰場上盡情作戰。自定義作戰序列和指揮鏈，組建屬於你的軍隊。直接在地圖上進行繪製，制定周密的作戰計劃，並交給麾下軍官執行。
games.short_description_en: Battleplan is a historical, WW2 real-time strategy game of unparalleled realism and simulation. Fight across massive battlefields created from real-world geographic data. Create your army by customizing your order of battle and chain of command. Draw directly on the map to create elaborate plans.

games.name: Planet Zoo 2
games.short_description: 在《動物園之星 2》中打造更具野性的世界。在全球各地創辦獨一無二的動物園，讓令人驚嘆的動物們齊聚一堂，包括全新登場的水生與飛行物種，並將你的經驗延伸至動物園之外，將動物野放到廣闊的野生動物保護區。
games.short_description_en: Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2. Create distinctive zoos around the globe filled with awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species, before taking your experience beyond the zoo to release your animals into expansive Wildlife Reserves.

games.name: Deep Dish Dungeon
games.short_description: 在這款生存探索遊戲中，你將深入處處皆謎題的精巧地城中冒險，體驗結合了類銀河戰士惡魔城與製作系統的玩法。可單人挑戰，也能透過線上合作模式與夥伴一同揭開地城的種種謎團。
games.short_description_en: A survival exploration game where you navigate through a puzzly hand-crafted dungeon, with metroidvania and crafting elements. Unravel the enigmas of the dungeon’s depths solo or online co-op multiplayer.

games.name: Double Dealers
games.short_description: 一款支持3–6名玩家的拍賣遊戲，圍繞虛張聲勢、欺騙與操控展開。你必須在緊張激烈的競價戰中智勝對手，隱藏真相，並將高風險交易轉化為利潤。每一輪都是心理博弈的較量，信任脆弱，策略決定勝負。
games.short_description_en: A 3–6 player auction game built around bluffing, deception, and manipulation, where you must outsmart your opponents in tense bidding wars, hide the truth, and turn risky trades into profit. Every round is a battle of mind games where trust is fragile and strategy decides the winner.

games.name: Haunted Heist
games.short_description: 《鬧鬼大劫掠》是一款支持 3-8 人對局的恐怖派對遊戲。盜寶者需要在隨機生成的宅邸中搜集寶石；搗蛋鬼則要用各式各樣的技能來嚇唬、干擾、消滅盜寶者，保護自己的家園。
games.short_description_en: Haunted Heist is a 3-8 player round-based PvP horror party game where Heisters find and retrieve gems in a procedurally generated mansion, while Tricksters use chaotic abilities to distress, disrupt, and dispose of them to protect their home.

games.name: Refund This Game
games.short_description: 在這款《掘地求升》式的 3D 高難度平臺遊戲裡，一路把自己彈到最頂端！把杆子戳到牆上，掰彎，再借著彈力把自己高速甩出去！一個失誤，你就可能掉回最底下。你能在兩小時內登頂，把這筆退款“賺”到手嗎？！
games.short_description_en: Fling yourself up to the top in this “Getting Over It”-like 3D platformer! Stick your pole to walls, bend it and fling yourself with great speed! One mistake means falling all the way down. Can you reach the summit in under 2 hours and EARN that refund?!

games.name: One Million Coins
games.short_description: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.
games.short_description_en: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.

games.name: over the hill
games.display_name: 越過山丘 over the hill
games.name_zh_cn: 越过山丘 over the hill
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 越過山丘 over the hill
games.short_description: 在越野的黃金年代，探索整個世界。獨自一人或跟友人同行，駕駛 60 至 80 年代的經典四輪驅動車，在崎嶇小徑與絕美風光之間來回穿梭。
games.short_description_en: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

games.name: Valor Mortis
games.short_description: 《Valor Mortis》是一款由 Ghostrunner 團隊打造的第一人稱動作魂系遊戲。你將化身為一名拿破崙軍隊的前士兵，在死亡後重生，掌握超自然力量，與恐怖怪物展開激戰，並揭開威脅全人類的驚天陰謀。
games.short_description_en: Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.short_description: 鮮紅的詛咒，會是絕望還是希望？ 在悪魔城伝説(Castlevania Dracula's Curse)的23年之後，隨著年輕的貝爾蒙特在巴黎冒險並成長。 KONAMI × Evil Empire × Motion Twin聯手推出最新的探索型2D動作遊戲。
games.short_description_en: Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow Rose Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

games.name: Among the Trolls
games.name_zh_cn: 黑森林迷踪 Among the Trolls
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 黑森林迷蹤 Among the Trolls
games.short_description: 《黑森林迷蹤》是一款第一人稱敘事冒險遊戲，你將會在其中揭開芬蘭森林的神秘謎團。冒險深入芬蘭的荒野，揭開家族的真相，直面潛藏在未知之中的存在。
games.short_description_en: Among the Trolls is a first-person narrative-adventure game where the secret mysteries of Finnish forests are unraveled. Venture deep into the Finnish wilderness to uncover family truths and confront what lies beyond.

games.name: The Witch's Bakery
games.short_description: 《The Witch's Bakery》是2D敘事冒險RPG遊戲，你將化身魔法烘焙師，在巴黎展開奇幻生活！服務顧客、造訪經典街道，用美味可頌療癒人們的心靈吧。🥐
games.short_description_en: The Witch's Bakery is a 2D narrative Adventure RPG where you live a magical life as a witch-baker in Paris! Serve customers, visit iconic streets and heal people's heart with your croissants 🥐

games.name: No Such Place
games.short_description: 《查無此地》是一款俯視角射擊撤離遊戲。作為超自然異常調查組織U.R.C.的成員，你被派往破碎的維度碎片執行勘察任務。在充滿未知威脅的環境中生存，蒐集物資與線索，並在限定時間內找到撤離點返回安全屋。透過蒐集到的各類物資信息，將被全人類遺忘的真相重新帶回這個世界...
games.short_description_en: Welcome to the Unknown Research Consortium (U.R.C.), where you’re tasked with conducting reconnaissance missions, terminating unknown threats, gathering crucial information, and reaching the evacuation point in this treacherous top-down extraction shooter.

games.name: Trash Day
games.short_description: 和你的浣熊小隊一起，展開最多 6 人、以物理互動為核心的合作冒險。搜刮垃圾、裝滿偷來的推車，再一路推向浣熊天堂。盡情享受浣熊生活！
games.short_description_en: Team up with your raccoon squad in this physics-based co-op adventure for up to 6 players. Scavenge trash, fill your stolen wagon, and haul it to Raccoon Paradise. Live your best raccoon life.

games.name: Total War: SHOGUN 2 - Complete Edition
games.display_name: 全軍破敵：幕府將軍2 完整版
games.name_zh_tw: 全軍破敵：幕府將軍2 完整版
games.name_zh_tw_traditional: 全軍破敵：幕府將軍2 完整版
games.short_description: 在更新並強化後的《全軍破敵：幕府將軍2 完整版》中統一日本，成為幕府將軍。有時締結同盟，有時安排敵後作戰。在回合制帝國建設與即時戰鬥無縫結合的玩法中運籌帷幄，並智取敵對氏族。
games.short_description_en: Unite Japan and become Shogun in the updated, enhanced and complete edition of Total War: SHOGUN 2. Build alliances, sabotage your enemies and outsmart your rival clans in a seamless blend of turn-based empire building and real-time battles.

games.name: Shipping Store Simulator 2037
games.short_description: 未來，您將成為一家破產快遞公司的經理。要麼事事親力親為，要麼用機器人和無人機實現自動化。VIP客戶、黑市、競爭對手的陰招和貨車競速——這些還只是這座活力四射、暗藏諸多秘密的城市的冰山一角。
games.short_description_en: You're the manager of a bankrupt delivery service in the future. Do everything yourself or automate with robots and drones. VIP customers, the black market, competitors' dirty tricks, and van races—just a glimpse of a vibrant city that holds many secrets.

games.name: Legion Was Here
games.display_name: 千面人在此 Legion Was Here
games.name_zh_tw: 千面人在此 Legion Was Here
games.name_zh_cn: 千面人在此 Legion Was Here
games.name_zh_tw_traditional: 千面人在此 Legion Was Here
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 千面人在此 Legion Was Here
games.short_description: 你是"千面人"，一名可以隨心所欲改變外表的秘密特工。運用你的調查技能和變色龍般的本領，潛入敵人內部！
games.short_description_en: Steal a face. Study a life. Survive the conversation.

games.name: Enshrouded
games.short_description: 《霧鎖王國》是一款單人及合作生存動作 RPG，你的自由與創意永遠是第一優先。征服吞噬餘火之谷的腐化迷霧「霧幕」：探索一個手工打造、充滿秘密的世界，隨心所欲塑造你的英雄，並在完全可改造的大地上，隨處建造任何東西。
games.short_description_en: Enshrouded is a solo and co-op survival action RPG where your freedom and creativity come first. Conquer the Shroud, a corrupting fog devouring the kingdom of Embervale: explore a handcrafted world full of secrets, forge your hero your way, and build anything, anywhere in a fully terraformable land.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.short_description: 在《Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2》中，以帝皇之名殲滅異端！在此復古第一人稱射擊遊戲《Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun》的續作中，扮演極限戰士馬魯姆·凱多或戰鬥修女尼拉·維拉斯，迎戰更多敵人、挑選更多武器，掌握全新的滅敵方式！
games.short_description_en: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with MORE enemies, MORE weapons, and NEW ways to purge!

games.name: Arknights: Endfield
games.short_description: 《明日方舟：終末地》是一款由Gryphline推出的3D即時策略RPG。玩家將作為終末地工業的管理員，探索塔衛二，保衛和拓展人類文明的邊疆。
games.short_description_en: Arknights: Endfield is a 3D real-time strategy RPG from Gryphline. You will take on the role of the Endministrator of Endfield Industries, explore Talos-II, and defend and expand the frontiers of human civilization.

games.name: Chained Beasts
games.short_description: CHAINED BEASTS是一款支援1至4名玩家合作的角鬥士類Roguelike遊戲。與你的夥伴相互鎖鏈，在混亂的戰鬥中並肩作戰。利用鎖鏈或競技場，以創意的方式擊敗敵人，贏得嗜血觀眾的歡呼。忍受身體與精神的創傷，打倒強大的首領，活到最後一刻。
games.short_description_en: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelike. Fight chaotic battles chained to your friends. Use your chains or the arena to beat up foes in creative ways and win over the bloodthirsty crowd. Endure physical and mental injuries to defeat fearsome bosses and survive the day.

games.name: Scam With Your Friends
games.short_description: 和朋友們一起經營一家詐騙呼叫中心。用越來越荒唐的騙局，騙光 AI 來電者畢生的積蓄。完成每日指標，把辦公室攪得天翻地覆，並在暴怒成性的老闆面前熬過一場殘酷的績效考核。
games.short_description_en: Run a scam call center with your friends. Use increasingly ridiculous schemes to trick AI callers out of their life savings. Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, and survive a brutal performance review from your rageaholic boss.

games.name: Stream Train
games.short_description: 在這款最多支持 6 人在線合作的恐怖遊戲中，直播自己在廢棄鐵路上的驚悚之旅。通過拍攝詭異怪物、表演危險特技以及惡搞好友來活躍直播氣氛。使用彈幕打賞購買燃料和裝備。你們能否活著離開恐怖谷？
games.short_description_en: An online co-op horror game where up to 6 players livestream their trip down an abandoned rail road. Keep your audience entertained by filming creatures, doing dangerous stunts, and pranking your friends. Use chatter donations to buy fuel and gear. Can you make it through the Uncanny Valley alive?

games.name: Beyond These Stars
games.display_name: 繁星之海 Beyond These Stars
games.name_zh_tw: 繁星之海 Beyond These Stars
games.name_zh_cn: 繁星之海 Beyond These Stars
games.name_zh_tw_traditional: 繁星之海 Beyond These Stars
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 繁星之海 Beyond These Stars
games.short_description: 在太空鯨魚的背上建造城市，於星際旅途中學會共存。管理複雜的供應鏈和人民需求，建立前哨站，遭遇外星生物，揭開宇宙奧秘。
games.short_description_en: Build a city on the back of a Space Whale and learn to coexist as you journey through the stars. Manage intricate supply chains and the needs of your people as you build outposts, meet aliens, and uncover the mysteries of the universe.

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.short_description: 透過解謎與對抗可怕的生物，揭開這則令人不安的故事背後的真相。……倘若這些不僅僅是噩夢呢？
games.short_description_en: Tenebris Somnia is a 2D retro survival horror adventure game with live action cutscenes created by an award winning film crew from Argentina. Unveil the depths of a disturbing story by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. ...What if they aren't just nightmares?

games.name: Online: 404
games.short_description: 開放世界生存模擬器，即使是經驗豐富的老玩家也必須重新思考他們慣常的生存方式，以及如何與周圍的世界互動。你可以單人遊玩或與朋友一起，跟隨劇情或自由探索——只是別忘了你最重要的裝備。
games.short_description_en: An open-world survival simulator where even seasoned veterans of the genre will have to rethink their typical survival approach and how they interact with the world around them. Play solo or with friends, follow the story or simply explore — just don’t forget your most important gadget.

games.name: Flipping is Hard
games.short_description: 沒有腳，只能滾。這是一款硬核又殘忍的遊戲，你將化身翻翻仔，一臺按鍵直立機，靠著翻滾去攀爬險阻、越過挑戰。你，有能力回到自己的主人身邊嗎？
games.short_description_en: No Legs. Just Flips. A hard and punishing game where you flip, fall, and climb as Flippy, using only rotation. Do you have what it takes to get back to Jeff?

games.name: Who's Cheating?
games.short_description: 人人都在賭，其中一人在出老千。在這款3至8人的社交推理遊戲裡，老千的眼鏡能看出下一把押哪裡會中，警衛則觀察牌桌、判讀賭注，決定誰該吃霰彈槍。開著近距離語音，說謊、偷竊、虛張聲勢樣樣來。
games.short_description_en: Everyone is gambling. One player is cheating. In this social deduction game for 3 to 8 players, the Cheater uses glasses that reveal the next winning bet while the Security Guard studies the tables, reads the bets and decides who gets the shotgun. Lie, steal and larp over proximity chat.

games.name: Athanasia
games.short_description: 走進第一人稱射擊恐怖遊戲《永生咒魘》頗具沉浸感的世界，步入荒廢的研究設施，對抗隨處可見的史前掠食者。智勝自然，深入險境，揭開設施隱藏的重重謎團。
games.short_description_en: Fight the past in Athanasia, an immersive horror FPS set in an abandoned research facility overrun with prehistoric predators. Outwit nature, delve deep and uncover the facility's mysteries.

games.name: Nomad Drive
games.short_description: 修復您破舊的房車，單人或1–4人合作駛向程序生成的末日後世界。收集資源，自訂您的房車，並盡可能長時間生存。
games.short_description_en: Repair your rundown RV and hit the road solo or in 1–4 player co-op through a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can.

games.name: We Were Here Tomorrow
games.short_description: 你和夥伴在一座神秘的諾契克設施中醒來，想不起來自己究竟為何會來到這裡。在這款非對稱的合作冒險遊戲當中，必須藉由溝通與合作才能揭開秘密的真相。唯有同心協力才能決定明日的命運...
games.short_description_en: You and your partner awaken inside a mysterious Norček facility with little recollection of how you got there. Communicate, cooperate, and unravel the secrets in this asymmetrical co-op adventure. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow…

games.name: Star Trek: Outposts Unknown
games.short_description: 在這款劇情導向的前哨站建造遊戲中，率領船員踏入奇異的新世界！一邊研究、探索、建設，一邊迎戰威脅新盟友的神秘宇宙力量。 艦長，您的冒險就此啟航！
games.short_description_en: Lead your crew across strange new worlds in this narrative driven outpost builder! Research, explore, and build as you face a mysterious cosmic force that threatens a new ally. Your adventure awaits, Captain!

games.name: Escape from Playtime
games.short_description: 這是一款支持1至4人在線合作的生存恐怖遊戲，你和好友被困在一座廢棄玩具工廠，一道神秘聲音不斷發號施令，卻沒人知曉它究竟有何目的。探索不斷變化的走廊，搜尋求生工具，對抗潛伏在暗處的怪物，想辦法活著逃出去。
games.short_description_en: An online 1-8 player co-op horror experience where you and your friends are trapped in an abandoned toy factory. A mysterious voice commands you for an unknown purpose as you explore shifting halls, scavenge for tools, and fight for survival against creatures that lurk in the dark.

games.name: The Wrong Way
games.short_description: The Wrong Way is a psychological horror experience about a camping trip that takes a dark turn when one friend drives home alone and ends up on a road he was never supposed to be on. Sometimes the most dangerous places are the ones you stumble into by accident.
games.short_description_en: The Wrong Way is a psychological horror experience about a camping trip that takes a dark turn when one friend drives home alone and ends up on a road he was never supposed to be on. Sometimes the most dangerous places are the ones you stumble into by accident.

games.name: Stupid Never Dies
games.short_description: 在這款爆速成長動作 RPG 中，把最弱殭屍戴維培養成超強戰力！吃掉敵人、奪取能力並不斷變身，勇闖危險異世界地城，只為救活凍死的茱莉亞！
games.short_description_en: Turn weak zombie Davy stupid strong, stupid fast in this Blazing Fast Growth action RPG! Devour enemies, steal powers, transform, and brave a deadly dungeon to revive frozen Julia.

games.name: Bruisers 2D Boxing
games.short_description: Bruisers is unlike any boxing game before it. Climb from amateur bouts to the top of the pros. Train, eat, fight, dope, and deal with anyone who wants a piece of you on the way up — but tread lightly. Some consequences here are fatal.
games.short_description_en: Bruisers is unlike any boxing game before it. Climb from amateur bouts to the top of the pros. Train, eat, fight, dope, and deal with anyone who wants a piece of you on the way up — but tread lightly. Some consequences here are fatal.

games.name: Halloween On Goober Street
games.short_description: Halloween On Goober Street is a first-person horror-comedy taking place on Halloween night. Players must Trick-or-Treat their way to 100 candies or face the consequences. With lots of fun interactions and scares with the zippiest of characters, this Halloween night is one sure to be remembered.
games.short_description_en: Halloween On Goober Street is a first-person horror-comedy taking place on Halloween night. Players must Trick-or-Treat their way to 100 candies or face the consequences. With lots of fun interactions and scares with the zippiest of characters, this Halloween night is one sure to be remembered.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
games.short_description: 如果「FINAL FANTASY」一直以點陣風格持續進化…… 本作是以此為概念，並以嶄新點陣風格描繪的「FINAL FANTASY」系列最新作品。 除了圍繞「水晶」展開的故事，以及回合制指令戰鬥與能力更換等系列經典要素外，亦收錄了豐富多樣的反覆遊玩內容。
games.short_description_en: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: ALYSSA
games.short_description: 《Don't Be Afraid》開發者新作。你將扮演一名被困在噩夢般莊園中的小女孩。在一扇扇緊閉的大門後，扭曲的住民、黑暗的秘密，以及遠超想象的陰謀正等待著你。
games.short_description_en: From the creator of Don't Be Afraid. You are a little girl trapped inside a nightmarish mansion, where twisted residents, dark secrets, and a conspiracy far greater than it first appears await behind every closed door.

games.name: Moon Sweepers
games.short_description: 整個月球等你打掃，開局只有一把牙刷。與好友組成最多16人的清潔小隊，收集並販售月塵，升級工具，解鎖清潔載具。把這份荒唐的工作變成蒸蒸日上的事業，前提是你的朋友真的肯幫忙。
games.short_description_en: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.

games.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
games.name_en: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
games.display_name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
games.short_description: 在一場以深受喜愛的《貓戰士》系列小說為靈感、身歷其境的動作冒險中，創造屬於你自己的貓戰士，並在湖區領地中展開旅程。狩獵、探索、與敵對部族戰鬥、揭開預言，並透過你做出的每個選擇，塑造屬於你的傳奇。
games.short_description_en: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

games.name: PAO PAO
games.short_description: 歡迎來到這座可愛的海濱小鎮！從零開始經營你夢想中的餐廳，烹飪一道道美味佳餚；單人掌勺或最多 4 人協作，讓後廚高效運轉。工作之餘，田間耕種、出海垂釣、探索森林，或在小鎮悠閒漫步——每一天都有新鮮事，讓這裡成為你的溫馨小家！
games.short_description_en: Welcome to PAO PAO! Discover a cozy seaside town full of little joys! Play solo or in co-op with up to three friends. Cook delicious meals, go fishing, grow crops, and create a home of your own by the sea.

games.name: Emberville
games.short_description: 在維特羅莫圖斯中甦醒，卻不帶任何記憶——這是一個龐大的地下世界，被創造成一座魔法地牢，在此死亡不再持久。探索它的深處，與危險生物戰鬥，拯救倖存者，並在重建淪為廢墟的餘燼鎮的同時，揭開這座監獄背後的真相。
games.short_description_en: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

games.name: Giggleland
games.short_description: Tolie isn’t allowed to leave the house. One night she wakes up alone in Giggleland, to a voice over the park speakers: her father is waiting for her at the information booth. A first-person psychological horror game in eight chapters. This game is not suitable for children.
games.short_description_en: Tolie isn’t allowed to leave the house. One night she wakes up alone in Giggleland, to a voice over the park speakers: her father is waiting for her at the information booth. A first-person psychological horror game in eight chapters. This game is not suitable for children.

games.name: Divine Frequency
games.short_description: 一個關於垃圾桶流浪漢如何崛起為宇宙最強安全軟件的離奇故事
games.short_description_en: A fever dream experience about the total collapse of reality as it lingers between states of erasure and transcendence.

games.name: Phantom Blade Zero
games.short_description: 由 S-GAME 自主研發與發行，採用 Unreal Engine 5 打造的暗黑武俠動作冒險遊戲。 你將化身為一名心臟重創、命僅餘六十六日的劍客，於刀光劍影與腥風血雨之間亡命逃亡，並一步步揭露籠罩整個武林的驚天陰謀。在這個失序、末法的江湖中，以身證道，以命尋心。
games.short_description_en: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.

games.name: Airport Contraband
games.short_description: 在這款結合 Roguelike 要素的模擬遊戲中，擔任海關人員，每隻行李箱都可能暗藏風險。檢查文件、盤問旅客、掃描行李並查扣違禁品，努力維持 Caldora 機場的秩序。你會堅守法律，還是靠走私品牟利？
games.short_description_en: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?

games.name: Playrooms
games.short_description: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.
games.short_description_en: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.

games.name: ATMOSFAR
games.short_description: 在驚險刺激的浮空島嶼世界中探索與求生，揭開人類最後前哨站的命運。獨自翱翔天際，或與好友組成中隊，駕駛飛船四處探索、收集資源，打造並升級專屬的飛行器。
games.short_description_en: Uncover the fate of humanity's final outpost as you survive and explore a thrilling world of floating islands. Brave the skies on your own or assemble a squadron of friends, and scavenge scrap to engineer and upgrade flying vessels, bringing your airship along for the journey.

games.name: Terrible Lizards
games.short_description: 《恐怖蜥蜴》是一款恐怖跑酷遊戲，背景設定在一個古老的66號公路景點……其地下潛藏著黑暗邪惡的事物。為了逃出生天，你必須快速移動、跨越險惡地形，並揭開「道爾頓恐龍樂園」究竟隱藏著什麼秘密。你最好快點跑起來。
games.short_description_en: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running.

games.name: Queen's Domain
games.short_description: 一款主打硬核戰鬥與穿行探索的復古奇幻動作RPG。踏上冒險旅程，前往神秘的尼亞希德島，尋找你失蹤的父王。此乃邪惡勢力盤踞之地，處處藏有奧秘玄機，而沉睡的女王也已漸漸甦醒……
games.short_description_en: A retro-fantasy action RPG with brutal combat and traversal-focused exploration. Embark on a quest to find your father who disappeared on the mysterious Isle of Neasied, where sinister forces gather, secrets hide everywhere, and the sleeping Queen has begun to stir…

games.name: HEART ABYSS
games.short_description: 《修羅的殺陣》是一款日式風格的快節奏砍殺平臺遊戲。遊戲中你化身為一位半人半狐的“忍狐”，踏上尋找失蹤姊姊的復仇之旅，遊戲強調快速而激烈的戰鬥節奏，挑戰玩家的反應與策略，在激烈的廝殺中化身修羅，斬殺一切擋路者吧！
games.short_description_en: Heart Abyss is a brutal action-platformer inspired by Japan during the 17th and 18th centuries. Wake up your inner beast and take vengeance on those who put a collar around your neck. Find your sister and uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of all jinkos.

games.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.name_en: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.display_name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.short_description: 終極怪獸競技場格鬥遊戲完全重製，強勢回歸。選擇你最愛的怪獸，在現實世界的城市與其他場景，施展各式殘暴攻擊。在本機合作模式或全新的線上多人模式中與朋友對戰。
games.short_description_en: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

games.name: Loftia
games.short_description: 歡迎來到「Loftia」！在這款溫馨的多人互動遊戲中，你可以打造一個更美好、更永續的未來。帶上新老朋友們，一起來種植、做手工藝、四處探索、裝飾房屋、為世界帶來充滿意義的影響吧！
games.short_description_en: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

games.name: Hull Rupture
games.short_description: 船艦停擺之時，即是人類滅亡之日。 在這款結合了基地管理與塔防要素的輕度 Rogue 遊戲中，你將掌管一艘太空船，把渺小的人類視為耗材，並抵禦外星生物無情的猛攻。你會發現，每一個導致滅團的決定，在當下看起來都是那麼地合情合理……
games.short_description_en: If the ship stops, humanity ends. Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

games.name: Horses of Hoofprint Bay
games.short_description: "《蹄印灣馬場》是一款溫馨治癒的手繪 2D 馬場經營模擬遊戲。 悉心照料你的馬匹，通過訓練提升它們的力量與膽量，參加各類賽事贏取獎金。繁育可愛的幼駒，探索風景優美的騎行路線，僱傭並管理員工，不斷擴建馬場，打造屬於你的夢想天地！"
games.short_description_en: Horses of Hoofprint Bay is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D barn buildup and simulation game. Take care of your horses, train them to build up their strength and confidence and compete for prize money! Breed adorable foals, explore beautiful trails, hire and manage staff and build the stable of your dreams!

games.name: County of Fortune
games.short_description: 在中世紀的背景下從零開始發展您的郡，這規模遠超單個城市。在廣闊多變的地形中確定合適的定居點選址，沿著河流與道路編織貿易網絡，並在您的區域逐漸成形時，管理市長、貴族和不同的文化分佈。這是一款規模大得多的城市建造遊戲，而你治下的每一個定居點的發展和表現，都由你完全定義。
games.short_description_en: Build an entire medieval county, not just a city. Found villages across a wide, varied landscape, weave trade along rivers and roads, and guide mayors, noble houses, and cultures as your region comes to life. A city-builder on a much bigger scale, no two counties are alike.

games.name: Cozy Game Restoration
games.short_description: 《時光電玩修復師》是一款風格靜謐的模擬遊戲。在這裡，你將親手喚醒那些被遺忘的懷舊卡匣。撕開包裝、撕掉舊標籤、刷掉厚厚的灰塵，將沾滿歲月痕跡的廢鐵，變回閃閃發光的收藏品。這裡沒有壓力、沒有失敗，只有重拾童年回憶的純粹喜悅。
games.short_description_en: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

games.name: just volleyball
games.short_description: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with simple controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!
games.short_description_en: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with simple controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.short_description: Avaris大陸正遭受腐蝕的摧殘，這是一種可怕的瘟疫，會將所有感染者變成扭曲的怪物。玩家將扮演年輕的遊牧民Eline，與盟友並肩作戰，拯救世界免於毀滅。
games.short_description_en: The population of Avaris is ravaged by the Corrosion, a terrible affliction that mutates all it infects into grotesque abominations. Play as Eline, a young nomad, and lead fierce battles alongside your allies to save the world from extinction.

games.name: Airframe Ultra
games.short_description: 想在巨城西域飆車，不贏就等著賠上性命。在這裡，只能靠著殺肉場拼裝的浮空賽車、一把破爛開山刀，在染血公路上殺出重圍。歡迎光臨超限聯賽，在這地下世界，只講暴力！
games.short_description_en: There's only two types of racers in Megacity West: The winners and the dead. Down here, you’ve got a chop shop Airframe, a rusted machete, and blood on the motorway. Welcome to the violent underground world of Ultra Circuit racing!

games.name: Underkeep
games.short_description: 在這款採用策略回合制戰鬥的地城探索角色扮演遊戲中，踏入危機四伏的奇幻世界。組建冒險隊伍、升級裝備，深入 Underkeep，揭開地底深處隱藏的秘密。
games.short_description_en: Explore a dangerous fantasy world in this role-playing dungeon crawler with tactical, turn-based combat. Assemble a party of adventurers, upgrade your gear and descend into the depths of the Underkeep to uncover what lies hidden below.

games.name: Ashes of the Singularity II
games.short_description: 在這款超大規模即時戰略遊戲中，指揮龐大軍團，爭奪整顆星球的控制權。率領地球勢力、機械化的 AI Substrate，或神秘莫測的後人類聯盟，在單人、多人合作或多人對戰中徵戰整個太陽系。
games.short_description_en: In this massive RTS game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer.

games.name: Stormforge
games.short_description: 在這款支援1至8名玩家的開放世界生存建造遊戲中，勇敢面對魔法風暴，在龍捲風的追擊下奮力求生。逃離龍捲風的追擊，或將風化為你的利器；航向新的島嶼；擊敗頭目以解鎖新職業；建造能抵禦下一次混沌風暴的家園。
games.short_description_en: Brave magical storms where tornadoes hunt you in this open-world survival crafting game for 1 to 8 players. Outrun the tornadoes or ride their winds, sail to new islands, defeat bosses to unlock classes, and build a home that can weather the next chaos storm.

games.name: Never Sort By Color
games.short_description: 在那座積木山的下面某處，埋著你的地板。用磁力手套、篩盤和追蹤零件的視覺，分揀這座不可能的「大堆」。裝滿貼好標籤的抽屜，取出零件，看著 MOC 一磚一瓦地咬合成型。愜意、滿足，只受一條規則支配：永遠不要按顏色分揀。
games.short_description_en: Somewhere under that mountain of bricks is your floor. Sort the impossible Pile with a magnet glove, sieves, and part-seeking vision. Fill labeled drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.

games.name: Shadow of the Road
games.short_description: 《暗影之路》是一款由情節驅動的回合制角色扮演遊戲，遊戲的舞臺為封建時代的日本，機械與魔法元素彼此交織。您需要招募各種各樣的角色組建隊伍，戰勝傳說中的妖怪與可怕的蒸汽朋克機械。在這個宏大的世界之中，您需要開闢屬於您自己的道路，由此改變帝國的命運。
games.short_description_en: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

games.name: Main Sequence
games.short_description: 《Main Sequence》是一款第一人稱太空模擬工廠建造遊戲。在遊戲中，你將設計宇宙飛船、建造空間站，並實現全面自動化。從一艘飛船起步，逐步發展成橫跨星際的工業帝國，在銀河中留下屬於你的印記。
games.short_description_en: Main Sequence is a first-person space-sim factory builder where you design spaceships, build space stations, and automate everything. Start with a single ship and grow to become an interstellar industrial empire as you leave your mark on the galaxy.

games.name: Trees Hate You
games.short_description: 穿越史上最邪惡的森林吧，那裡遍地都是世上最恐怖的樹木，千萬不要相信它們。那些樹木會欺騙你；會玩弄你；會傷害你，要是你能找到一把斧頭就好了……
games.short_description_en: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

games.name: Flick
games.short_description: 只需輕輕一撥開關，現實就在你眼前翻轉，把你拽入光怪陸離的世界，去揭開家族扭曲的過往。在這款心理恐怖遊戲中，前進離不開光，光卻也會召喚出最駭人的夢魘，你必須在兩者之間小心拿捏。
games.short_description_en: That feeling when you turn off the lights and run upstairs before something grabs you is now a game. A psychological horror experience where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

games.name: Reshine
games.short_description: 拂去積塵、除去鏽跡、抹去歲月的痕跡，溫柔修復古老物件。你可以在《Reshine》中獲得極簡主義的放鬆體驗：使用各種工具，親眼見證經年的汙垢在你眼前消融。無需經營，毫無壓力 - 只有你，以及讓復古珍寶重獲新生的滿滿成就感。
games.short_description_en: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

games.name: Am I Nima
games.short_description: 在《Am I Nima》這款心理恐怖遊戲中，你必須設法說服媽媽，讓她相信你確實是她的女兒。你要組合各種詞彙來和媽媽對話，以取得她的信任。
games.short_description_en: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

games.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
games.short_description: 在這場迷人的 3D 合作冒險中，透過一隻勇敢小老鼠的眼睛看世界。探索受瑞典北部啟發的壯麗景色、解開謎題，並在這片以溫暖敘事與自然之美交織而成的土地上，成為帶來善意的力量。
games.short_description_en: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

games.name: Blind Descent
games.short_description: 《Blind Descent》是一款深入火星地底未知領域的開放世界生存冒險遊戲。可單人遊玩，也可與好友進行4人合作模式，一同尋找失蹤的隊伍。透過打造自訂工具、升級基地，以及/或是在這個詭譎的異星世界中讓自身產生變異，以適應環境並求得生存。
games.short_description_en: Blind Descent is an open-world survival adventure into the mysteries of the Martian depths. Play solo or with friends in 4-player co-op as you search for the missing team. Adapt to survive by building custom tools, upgrading your base, and/or mutating in this bizarre alien world.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.short_description: 進入廣受好評的平臺跳躍遊戲，踏上大膽的重述之旅，體驗全新視覺與再次講述的故事。支援單人或最多 4 人線下同樂——一起探索神秘的新世界、搖滾全新音樂關卡，並發掘更多驚喜！
games.short_description_en: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or in up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.short_description: 利用成就感十足的戰略玩法，重回這個即時戰略遊戲系列的根源。指揮四種獨特的《Warhammer 40,000》派系，包含在本系列初次登場的機械修會！在超過 70 個史詩戰役任務以及值得一玩再玩的背水一戰 (Last Stand)、小規模衝突 (Skirmish) 與多人模式中奮勇殺敵。
games.short_description_en: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.name: Dumpster Gang
games.short_description: 至多4人聯機，滿城作案！翻垃圾桶、順零食、薅到就是賺到。沙雕物理全程整活，離譜委託接不停——只要小心被抓。今晚，當一隻不講武德的浣熊吧！
games.short_description_en: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

games.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux
games.short_description: 吐出靈魂的人是你，還是她？和愛你愛到想殺了你的惡魔，來場俄羅斯輪盤式的拚酒生存戰。喝得越醉，就越能打破規則，享受這個快活到死的瘋狂夜晚。
games.short_description_en: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

games.name: Never Be Alone
games.short_description: 《Never Be Alone》是一款開放世界殭屍生存遊戲，支援單人遊玩與無縫合作。疫情爆發十年後，探索一個被大自然重新佔領的世界，守護脆弱的安全區，並揭開你失落過往背後的真相。
games.short_description_en: Never Be Alone is an open-world zombie survival game for solo play and seamless co-op. Explore a world reclaimed by nature, protect a fragile safezone, and uncover the truth behind your forgotten past 10 years after the outbreak.

games.name: Attack on Titan 3 / A.O.T. 3
games.short_description: 本作是能從頭到尾完整體驗劇情的《進擊的巨人》遊戲系列集大成之作。立體機動動作再度進化，敬請享受系列中最頂尖、最暢快且華麗的動作表現。
games.short_description_en: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

games.name: Armatus
games.short_description: 《阿瑪塔斯》是一款第三人稱 roguelite 射擊遊戲，故事背景是已淪為廢墟，群魔橫行的巴黎。化身古老教團唯一倖存的異能戰士，手握強大火器與超凡的神賜之力，踏遍城市每個角落，尋找通向天堂的隱秘門戶：無光之門。
games.short_description_en: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

games.name: Danganronpa 2x2
games.short_description: 造訪賈巴沃克島的學生們，因為黑白熊的陰謀而被迫進行自相殘殺，不得不展開班級審判以找出犯人。駁倒對方發言中的矛盾，在高速推理動作遊戲中揭穿殺人事件的真相！同步收錄全新故事與原作劇情的雙份體驗！
games.short_description_en: While on a school trip to Jabberwock Island, students are ensnared in Monokuma’s deadly game, forced into mutual killing and Class Trials to expose the culprit. Break through contradictions with high-speed detective action. Includes both a brand-new scenario and the enhanced original!

games.name: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
games.short_description: 這是一個關於沒有容身之處的男人們，歷經50年為了追求歸所而戰的故事。 透過5個時代與5座城市來描繪動盪的近代日本。 可遊玩逼真血腥幹架的戰鬥系統以及經營秀場生意，享受身為「經紀人」的成功故事。 由「人中之龍工作室」出品的戲劇冒險最新力作。
games.short_description_en: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.

games.name: ANANTA
games.short_description: 《無限大》是一款都市題材開放世界RPG。你將扮演不同角色，從重霄到新啟，穿梭於繁華街頭和隱秘角落，漫步在茶山古鎮與老城巷陌。在不同城市間探索，結識各具魅力的夥伴，建立自己的專屬團隊。
games.short_description_en: Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG. Play as a variety of characters and explore everything from bustling business districts and hidden alleyways, to quiet tea towns and buzzing old streets. Rub shoulders with a wide-ranging cast of intriguing characters as you assemble a team all your own.

games.name: TankRat
games.short_description: 在一個瀕死的世界，血肉被鋼鐵所取代。成群的機械怪獸在荒野之中遊蕩。搜索並摧毀、拾荒並拆解，在殘骸之中重建自己。你奪取的東西，就會成為你的樣子。在荒野中生存，前往 Highpoint。
games.short_description_en: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

games.name: Tropico 7
games.short_description: 富貴險中求！在《海島大亨7》中，你將再次套進他那雙鵑亮的靴子，親手打造屬於自己的群島王國，並字面上的移山填海。作為光榮領袖，帶領您忠誠的海島居民（以及您的瑞士銀行帳戶）穿越時代，走向前所未有的繁榮。
games.short_description_en: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

games.name: Elta: Defy All Gods
games.short_description: 與你的龍神夥伴並肩，在受腐化的世界中一路殺出生天！在這款令人腎上腺素飆升的動作平臺遊戲中，盡情體驗自由近戰、流暢平臺動作與科幻探索的完美融合，成為隕落神明艾爾塔的鬥士。
games.short_description_en: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

games.name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe™: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
games.name_en: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe™: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
games.display_name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe™: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
games.short_description: Grab your sword. Eternia needs you. You have the power!
games.short_description_en: Grab your sword. Eternia needs you. You have the power!

games.name: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
games.short_description: 由Marvelous與Vanillaware聯合呈獻，絢爛繪卷和風動作 RPG《朧村正怪奇譚》正式登場。在妖怪肆虐的元祿之世，盡情領略六段奇幻怪談與暢快淋漓的劍戟動作體驗。
games.short_description_en: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.

games.name: METRO 2039
games.short_description: 《戰慄深隧2039》 即將重新定義第一人稱射擊遊戲，由廣受好評的敘事遊戲團隊 4A Games 推出。深入末日後莫斯科的黑暗腹地，在攸關地鐵存亡的苦痛爭鬥中尋找出路。
games.short_description_en: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

games.name: Outward 2
games.short_description: 《物質世界2：遠徵》是一款融合生存、探索與硬核戰鬥的開放世界ARPG。在這裡你不是天命之子，而是必須步步為營，對抗饑寒、管理揹包並在戰前做好萬全規劃的普通冒險者。前路嚴酷且未知，但每一次死裡逃生都將化為成長的養分。背起行囊，踏出城牆！一場足以讓你銘記的凡人史詩正等你啟程！
games.short_description_en: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements, focusing around a grounded experience. There’s no hand-holding, no scaled encounters, no divine blessings to make you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: an unforgiving, rewarding adventure awaits.

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.short_description: 經營一家打造世界上最偉大 MMORPG 的遊戲工作室。 僱用設計師、程式員和測試人員，創建一個奇幻世界，然後迎接數百名虛擬玩家。 如果他們感到無聊，他們會取消訂閱，而你的投資者將會找你算帳。 你甚至可以玩自己做的遊戲。
games.short_description_en: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.short_description: 體驗蘿拉·卡芙特首次歷險的震懾人心全新演繹，探索亞特蘭提斯的失落秘密，感受令人驚嘆的視覺效果、現代化的遊戲玩法及向原作精神致敬的全新驚喜。
games.short_description_en: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

games.name: Persona 4 Revival
games.short_description: 「你有聽過深夜電視嗎？」青春×超自然×離奇事件交織而成，無可取代的一年將會等著你！席捲鄉下小鎮的殺人案跟詭異的都市傳說。與覺醒心之力「人格面具」的夥伴們一同阻止事件發生，踏上尋求真相的旅途吧！
games.short_description_en: Step into a Supernatural Turn-Based RPG Adventure Solve Mysteries, Strengthen Bonds, and Awaken Your Persona

games.name: Fable
games.short_description: 在沉浸式的開放世界動作角色扮演遊戲中，成為你自己心目中的英雄。在這裡，每個選擇都將形塑你的旅程，名聲就是一切，而童話般幸福快樂的結局並非必然的終點。
games.short_description_en: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

games.name: GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT
games.short_description: 嶄新的鋼彈體驗，自此開始。 《GUNDAM 異軌征途》是能駕駛自由搭配各種裝備與技能的鋼彈，體驗高速自在的高機動戰鬥的動作遊戲。
games.short_description_en: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

games.name: Road Kings
games.short_description: 駕駛四十噸級大卡車，穿梭美國南方沿海平原，管理多重任務、各式拖車與路線。從菜鳥到資深獨立車主，化險為夷、擊敗勁敵，成為真正的公路之王。
games.short_description_en: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.

games.name: PHASE ZERO
games.short_description: 一場詭異的疾病籠罩 Flint Peak 小鎮，神秘生物在街頭遊蕩，幾名倖存者設法逃出生天。在這款經典風格的生存恐怖遊戲中，面對駭人怪物、解開謎題並查明真相。你能逃離這場惡夢嗎？
games.short_description_en: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Several survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and uncover the truth in this classic survival horror. Can you escape the nightmare?

games.name: Altiros
games.short_description: 建造、製作、破壞！在這款以奇幻浮空島世界為舞臺的線上沙盒冒險中，躍上雲端，運用鋼鐵、魔法與靈魂之力，在講究技巧的戰鬥中對抗可愛的怪物！
games.short_description_en: Build! Craft! Destroy! Jump on clouds and fight cute monsters in skill-based battles of steel, magic and spirit in this online sandbox adventure set in a fantastical world of sky islands!

games.name: Planetbase 2
games.short_description: 移民太陽系。在近未來時代，指揮人類小隊嘗試在火星及更多星球上建造基地。種植糧食、開採資源、製造商品，堅毅面對各個星球嚴苛環境帶來的重重挑戰。
games.short_description_en: Colonize the Solar System. Command a group of near-future humans trying to establish a base on Mars and beyond. Grow food, mine resources, manufacture goods and face the challenges these unforgiving worlds will throw at you.

games.name: ReVamp
games.short_description: 化身德古拉，統御城堡、抵禦凡人的侵襲。在這款城堡防禦肉鴿遊戲中，以鮮血為磚，鑄造你的要塞，部署致命防線，統帥魑魅軍團，守護王座。這是一場永無止盡的戰爭——為了你再也救不回的那份愛。
games.short_description_en: A Tower Defensevania where you rule as Dracula. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.

games.name: EXODUS
games.short_description: 踏入《EXODUS™》的世界，以遙遠未來的全新科幻宇宙為舞臺，展開一場電影般的單人動作 RPG 史詩。從一介遺跡拾荒師，蛻變為覓星旅者，探索遭時間效應摧殘的未知世界，深入宇宙最危險的邊陲，尋找人類存續的關鍵。
games.short_description_en: Step forward into EXODUS™ — a cinematic, single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe. Rise from salvager to Traveler, discover new worlds ravaged by the effects of time, and search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
games.short_description: 賭上星球未來，與賽菲羅斯展開最終決戰。 「FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE」專案完結篇。駕駛飛空艇翱翔天際，探索廣闊世界，與夥伴們一同挑戰全面進化的戰鬥。未知的旅程，終將抵達終點。所有命運，都將在此交匯。
games.short_description_en: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

games.name: Mariachi Legends
games.short_description: 你是帕勃羅·克魯茲，一位被死神選中的偵探。你獲得了“魅影”之力，要潛入聖馬斯科塔城。作為動作平臺跳躍遊戲，Mariachi Legends 融合了墨西哥民間傳說與經典街機玩法，帶你穿行於死者再次復活的世界。
games.short_description_en: Mariachi Legends is a brutal, pixel art, combat-oriented Metroidvania set in the heart of Mexico.You play as Pablo Cruz, a detective who has agreed to a deal with Death herself. She has given Pablo the ability to transform into the mighty La Sombra allowing him to fight back against evil.

games.name: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus
games.short_description: 《小馬島2：熊貓馬戲團》是一場交替穿梭於時間、神話、神學以及電子遊戲之間的旅行。你需要在逃脫地獄眾神的同時，保持你的靈魂和理智的完好。這絕對不是關於小馬的遊戲。
games.short_description_en: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games. Escape the lordly deities of the underworld with your soul, and your sanity, intact. This is not a game about ponies.
